system.description:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to
activate a survival overclock, pushing
your survival gear, reflex software,
hazard filters, movement assists,
terrain scanners, and emergency
stimulants past their safe limits.
Describe how you shift into survival
mode, then place a d6 on this card with
the 1 value facing up. While the
Survival Overclock Die is active, you
add its value to every action roll you
make.
After you add its value to a roll,
increase the Die’s value by one.
When the die’s value would exceed 6 or
you take a rest, the overclock burns out
and you must mark an additional
Stress.
